svg.title: What happens when backing falls?
svg.desc: Five quantities in stacked rows over seven policy steps: normal accrual, reserve loss, deficit, deficit repair, reserve rebuilding, floor restoration, renewed index growth. Each column reconciles backing plus deficit equals principal plus accrued plus reserve. Separate tables show recorded Python loss_then_recovery and local CascadeVaultUSYC yield-run checkpoints.
svg.text: Python reference / USYC policy · each column is one complete accounting state.
Stacked totals: backing + deficit (left), principal + accrued + reserve (right). All bars share a dollar scale.

g.text: Day 2: $1 yield claimed as spot before loss. Day 3: $1 new Issue; repair restores $0.50 of the $1 floor.

a.text: CascadeVaultUSYC · local yield run · MockUSYC prices

g.text: During deficit: Claim / Withdraw suspended. Principal and prior claims stay intact; payments can continue.
